Also possibly "行贿" but the person didn't give bribe, they forged a document. The crime is forging official documents and using them. In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of "伪造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪" (forgery of state documents, certificates, seals). Also "买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章罪" if they sell. Here they forged and used. So the charge: 伪造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪. Possibly also "投机倒把"? No. So answer: [罪名]伪造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪<eoa>.
